description: NaPH₂OF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnna space group. Na is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra and corners with four equivalent PF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-69°. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.43 Å. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.31 Å. P is bonded to six F atoms to form PF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-51°. All P-F bond lengths are 1.64 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one P atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom.
